items.example: The aviation regulator grounded flights across America for almost five hours after a telecommunications outage affected air-traffic controllers.
items.analysis_zh: telecommunications outage 是通信服务中断的名词搭配，outage 为可数名词，可与 power、network、service 组合。它与 slowdown 不同，后者仅表示速度下降；这里影响空管人员，体现基础设施中断对航空网络的连锁影响。 在这条具体新闻中，词语与前后因果关系相互呼应，复述时应保留相应的动词搭配和限定条件，避免改变事件发生的时间或证据确定程度。

items.example: The transport secretary pointed to ageing legacy equipment as a possible source of vulnerability.
items.analysis_zh: legacy equipment 中 legacy 是前置形容词，指长期沿用且升级困难的设备。它不等于 broken，旧系统仍可能运行；legacy systems、legacy software 是企业数字化改造中常见术语，通常暗示维护和兼容性风险。 在这条具体新闻中，词语与前后因果关系相互呼应，复述时应保留相应的动词搭配和限定条件，避免改变事件发生的时间或证据确定程度。

items.example: The treasury secretary accused another US department of failing to restrict Nvidia chip exports.
items.analysis_zh: restrict exports 是政策报道的及物动词结构，restrict 直接跟 exports，不用介词 on。它与 ban 有区别，ban 通常表示全面禁止，restrict 可以包含许可证、数量和用途限制；还可说 restrict access to technology。 在这条具体新闻中，词语与前后因果关系相互呼应，复述时应保留相应的动词搭配和限定条件，避免改变事件发生的时间或证据确定程度。

items.example: He also criticised delays in a regulatory crackdown on a Singapore-based company linked to an alleged intelligence figure.
items.analysis_zh: a crackdown on a company 是名词搭配，crackdown 后常接 on 表示整治对象。它比 investigation 更强调强硬的监管或执法行动，常与 launch、intensify、delay 搭配；这里的 delays 指行动尚未及时推进。 在这条具体新闻中，词语与前后因果关系相互呼应，复述时应保留相应的动词搭配和限定条件，避免改变事件发生的时间或证据确定程度。

items.example: Several prominent figures were asked to testify before Congress, though the accusations remain contested.
items.analysis_zh: testify before Congress 是正式听证语境，testify 为不及物动词，before 引出机构；testify under oath 表示宣誓作证。它与 speak to lawmakers 相比具有正式法律程序色彩，但被要求作证并不代表已经被定罪。 在这条具体新闻中，词语与前后因果关系相互呼应，复述时应保留相应的动词搭配和限定条件，避免改变事件发生的时间或证据确定程度。

items.example: A tanker struck a cruise ship docked in New Orleans, leaving the passenger vessel tilted in the Mississippi River.
items.analysis_zh: a ship docked in New Orleans 中 docked 是过去分词，作后置修饰语，表示船舶当时已靠港。它与 anchored 不同，anchored 更强调抛锚停泊；物流沟通中 a vessel docked at the terminal 可明确船舶的泊位状态。 在这条具体新闻中，词语与前后因果关系相互呼应，复述时应保留相应的动词搭配和限定条件，避免改变事件发生的时间或证据确定程度。

items.example: The Coast Guard suggested that the tanker had lost steering but said the precise cause was unknown.
items.analysis_zh: lose steering 是船舶失去转向控制的固定搭配，steering 在此为不可数名词。与 lose power 强调动力故障不同，lost steering 指方向控制问题；had lost steering 用过去完成时描述碰撞前可能出现的情况。 在这条具体新闻中，词语与前后因果关系相互呼应，复述时应保留相应的动词搭配和限定条件，避免改变事件发生的时间或证据确定程度。

items.example: Investigators avoided assigning blame before the inquiry was complete.

items.example: Microsoft said its software services had been fully restored after a global disruption affected Outlook, Teams and Copilot.
items.analysis_zh: had been fully restored 是过去完成时被动语态，说明在公司通报之前服务已经恢复。restore services 和 restore access 是事故报告常见搭配；与 restart servers 不同，restore 更强调用户实际功能恢复。 在这条具体新闻中，词语与前后因果关系相互呼应，复述时应保留相应的动词搭配和限定条件，避免改变事件发生的时间或证据确定程度。

items.example: The company apologised and reported no evidence of malicious activity.
items.analysis_zh: malicious activity 是网络安全语境中的形容词加名词搭配，表示蓄意破坏行为。它比 suspicious activity 语气更强；no evidence of malicious activity 是谨慎的证据表述，不能据此推断调查已排除所有风险。 在这条具体新闻中，词语与前后因果关系相互呼应，复述时应保留相应的动词搭配和限定条件，避免改变事件发生的时间或证据确定程度。

items.example: It said email queues had shrunk considerably as systems recovered.
items.analysis_zh: email queues 指邮件系统等待处理的任务队列，queue 是可数名词，复数可指多个队列。queues had shrunk 说明积压量减少，并不表示邮件被删除；processing queues、order queues 也适用于软件和供应链管理。 在这条具体新闻中，词语与前后因果关系相互呼应，复述时应保留相应的动词搭配和限定条件，避免改变事件发生的时间或证据确定程度。

items.example: Several former officials were taken into custody during corruption probes.
items.analysis_zh: be taken into custody 是法律报道中的固定被动结构，into 表示进入拘押状态，custody 通常不可数。它与 convicted、sentenced 明显不同，拘押不意味着定罪；这种用词避免把调查阶段误写成审判结论。 在这条具体新闻中，词语与前后因果关系相互呼应，复述时应保留相应的动词搭配和限定条件，避免改变事件发生的时间或证据确定程度。

items.analysis_zh: a perennial challenge 中 perennial 是前置形容词，强调多年持续、反复出现的问题。它与 temporary 相对，也比 current 更强调长期性；perennial problem、perennial concern 可用于项目风险和国际政治分析。 在这条具体新闻中，词语与前后因果关系相互呼应，复述时应保留相应的动词搭配和限定条件，避免改变事件发生的时间或证据确定程度。

passages.title: US aviation faces nationwide disruption
passages.body: The aviation regulator {{2026-11-14-aviation-grounded}} flights across America for almost five hours after a telecommunications {{2026-11-14-aviation-outage}} affected air-traffic controllers. Officials said there was no evidence of a cyberattack. The transport secretary pointed to ageing {{2026-11-14-aviation-legacy}} equipment as a possible source of vulnerability. Thousands of flights were cancelled before normal operations could resume.

passages.title: Chip export policy comes under scrutiny
passages.body: The treasury secretary accused another US department of failing to {{2026-11-14-chips-restrict}} Nvidia chip exports. He also criticised delays in a regulatory {{2026-11-14-chips-crackdown}} on a Singapore-based company linked to an alleged intelligence figure. Nvidia shares fell on Friday as the controversy grew. Several prominent figures were asked to {{2026-11-14-chips-testify}} before Congress, though the accusations remain contested.

passages.title: Tanker collides with cruise ship
passages.body: A tanker struck a cruise ship {{2026-11-14-collision-docked}} in New Orleans, leaving the passenger vessel tilted in the Mississippi River. Rescue teams brought everyone to safety, although dozens were injured. The Coast Guard suggested that the tanker had lost {{2026-11-14-collision-steering}} but said the precise cause was unknown. Investigators avoided assigning {{2026-11-14-collision-blame}} before the inquiry was complete.

passages.title: Microsoft recovers from service outage
passages.body: Microsoft said its software services had been fully {{2026-11-14-microsoft-restored}} after a global disruption affected Outlook, Teams and Copilot. The company apologised and reported no evidence of {{2026-11-14-microsoft-malicious}} activity. It said email {{2026-11-14-microsoft-queues}} had shrunk considerably as systems recovered. Operations appeared to be approaching normal levels.

passages.title: Hungary probes concealed cash
passages.body: Hungary's anti-corruption agency said it had {{2026-11-14-hungary-recovered}} billions of dollars in hidden cash. Some of the money was reportedly {{2026-11-14-hungary-buried}} in forests, according to accounts of the investigation. Several former officials were taken into {{2026-11-14-hungary-custody}} during corruption probes. The inquiries formed part of the new government's transparency campaign.

passages.title: ASEAN leaders confront regional strains
passages.body: Southeast Asian leaders met in Manila after war in Iran had {{2026-11-14-asean-slashed}} energy supplies and driven up fuel prices. Disputes in the South China Sea remained a {{2026-11-14-asean-perennial}} challenge, with a maritime agreement unlikely to meet its deadline. Fighting between Cambodia and Thailand added to the diplomatic agenda. Foreign leaders were expected to hold talks on the summit's {{2026-11-14-asean-sidelines}}.
